[[File:Bone mace detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''bone mace''' is a weapon requiring level 50 [[Attack]] to wield. It is made by combining a [[rune mace]] with [[Scurrius' spine]] at an [[anvil]], requiring a [[hammer]] and level 35 [[Smithing]] to do so; players without the required level can alternatively pay [[Historian Aldo]] 50,000 [[coins]] to create it on their behalf. The mace has almost identical stats to the [[dragon mace]], missing only the 5 [[prayer bonus]].

As a [[rat bone weapon]], it is effective against all types of [[rat (attribute)|rats]] by adding 10 damage to the player's [[maximum hit]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1754468057638973449|date=5 February 2024|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106036|archivedate=5 February 2024|quote=Looks like a static +10 in the code, from what I can see.}} Additionally, it has no attack cooldown when attacking the [[Giant rat (Scurrius)|giant rats]] that [[Scurrius]] summons. The mace '''cannot be used''' against any other type of monster (including manual cast [[spell]]s); doing so will yield the game message {{Mes|You can only use this weapon against rats.}}

==Trivia==
* The weapon seems to resemble a flail, rather than a mace. The former is a weapon that has a striking head connected to a handle via a chain or rope, while the latter consists of only a handle with a striking head attached directly on top.
* The weapon shares attack animations with the two-handed [[Verac's flail]] despite the Bone mace being one-handed.
* The rat bone weapons were based on a suggestion by a user named ''N1nja_P1g'', and was credited by [[Mod Jerv]] for the suggestion that inspired the in-game designs.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Jerv|url=https://twitter.com/JagexJerv/status/1750118834327982369|date=24 January 2024|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/108643|archivedate=2 February 2023|quote=I would like to shout out @N1nja_P1g for the awesome player suggestions that helped inspire the final designs. Especially the addition of stinky cheese and the mace!}}
